data.body:
[P2] Preserve pending bindings when collection time expires

If a completed read batch discovers a retry's `WRAPPER_ENTER` and a later batch exhausts the budget, this branch caches the records but exits before `_bind_requests()`. The evidence builder then records an unbound-launch `collectionErrors` entry. The coordinator treats that retained error as a cleanup failure even if retirement subsequently binds and drains the request, leaving the target fenced. Safely reconcile completed streams or retain unfinished bindings as pending collection. Add a regression covering budget exhaustion after discovering a new native request.
